name: mdast
description: Markdown parsed by remark, including GFM strike. Checks the public Markdown importer too.

name: hast
description: HTML parsed by rehype. Covers authored attributes, destinations, code and block nesting.

name: commonmark.js
description: The JavaScript CommonMark reader and renderer. Unsupported GFM strike is reported explicitly.

name: cmark
description: The native reference reader. XML text nodes preserve whitespace between adjacent inline elements.

name: djot.js
description: Djot parsing, rendering and writing. A tested workaround covers the pinned writer's hard-break crash.

name: Docutils
description: Native doctrees and HTML output. Loose-list layout and heading-level boundaries are recorded.

name: Asciidoctor.js
description: Block structure comes from Asciidoctor. Converted HTML supplies inline semantics, with a documented comparison limit.

name: MD4C
description: A small C driver captures parser events and native HTML. Unbalanced event streams fail validation.
